note: Sealed held-out set. Written on 2026-11-06 BEFORE the temporal parser (combine v3) was built, and kept outside the project until that code was frozen, so it measures generalization honestly. Golds follow the written urgency definition: now = an explicit need within about 90 days (or ASAP language); this_quarter = about 3 to 6 months out, or budget/planning-cycle language without a nearer date; exploring = more than 6 months out, or explicit exploring/no-rush language without a nearer date; unknown = no timing information. All people and messages are synthetic. receivedAt is Tue 2026-11-10, 10:00 AM ET.
